text: Stop washing your face in the morning. You may be destroying the protective barrier your skin spent all night building, and that ages you faster than the sun. The industry convinced you that clean equals healthy. That is a lie designed to sell you more products. In Chinese medicine, we have never washed the face in the morning, not once in thousands of years. While you sleep, your skin produces natural oils called sebum. That is not dirt. It is the moisturizer your body makes on its own, loaded with vitamin E and compounds that protect you against bacteria and pollution. When you wash it off every morning, three things happen. First, you strip away your acid mantle, the layer that keeps bad bacteria out. Second, your skin panics and produces more oil to compensate. That is why your face feels tight after washing and greasy by noon. Third, you damage your skin barrier. Then come the fine lines, the sensitivity and the breakouts. Your skin has its own microbiome. Washing it twice a day destroys the good bacteria that keep it clear and youthful. In the morning, just splash your face with cool water. Save washing for the night. Give it two weeks and your skin will find its balance. But the outside habit is only the first step. In Chinese medicine, clear skin always starts in the gut. Your body cannot build a strong barrier on the outside if on the inside it is struggling. And your gut does not struggle only because of what you eat. Stress inflames the skin from within. Anxiety disrupts the hormones that control oil production. The emotions you accumulate show up as breakouts, redness, and premature aging. That is why people spend hundreds on creams and still have damaged skin. Write in the comments, clear skin. If you are going to try this, and if you want to learn how to care for your skin from where it truly begins, to calm what inflames it from the inside, I spent over 20 years learning in silence how to do exactly that. And everything I know is inside the way back to stillness. The link is in my profile.
